It’s the fifty silver and one standard pull a day from dailies of that month, assuming you got them every day. So if you’ve gotten every one since July 1 I believe you’d get 2500 silver and 50 standard pulls, as that would triple your daily reward for the 25 days we’ve had (todays as well if already claimed). I haven’t checked on it myself, as I usually get it early.
(Sometimes the curriculum seasons have been only two weeks, but that isn’t the case currently)
